reporting-org.narrative: FMO NV (Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V.)

description.narrative: FMO’s financing will be used to finance the construction of the Project which will be the first solar PV plant and Independent Power Producer in the country upon its completion. Malawi has abundant solar resource availability and the Project can assist Malawi in diversifying its electricity mix and reducing its reliance on import of fossil fuels.
